title: Capitals of the Americas
intro: Pick the capital city of each country in the Americas.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)?
questions.explain: Caracas is the capital of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of).

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago?
questions.explain: Port-of-Spain is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Nicaragua?
questions.explain: Managua is the capital of Nicaragua.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Dominica?
questions.explain: Roseau is the capital of Dominica.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Haiti?
questions.explain: Port-au-Prince is the capital of Haiti.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of El Salvador?
questions.explain: San Salvador is the capital of El Salvador.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Paraguay?
questions.explain: Asunción is the capital of Paraguay.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Honduras?
questions.explain: Tegucigalpa is the capital of Honduras.
